findings: All1408lines of app.py read. Original _save_cache and _load_cache method bodies executed using controlled cache dependency and UI values, removing annotations only. No GUI or actual cache filesystem writes.
_save_cache takes settings from current UI, not the completed hash/projection job. Control confirms old.png results passed with current phash settings. No recipe/job generation contract checked here.

_load_cache ignores false copy_hashes_to return and returnsTrue after restoring results; controlled failure confirms successful return. This can leave no hashes or stale work-directory hashes for later hot-swap.

Queue handling does not reject stale job generation; malformed cluster payload validation becomes an empty ClusterResult and then proceeds through ordinary _on_cluster_done/save. Source-only, no event-loop run.

Reprojection launch checks full pipeline _running but not _proj_running; cluster launch does not serialize _cluster_running. Shared outputs/late events remain caller-level concerns, no concurrent race executed.
Browse clears displayed data without cancelling ongoing pipeline. Close removes temporary directory without cancelling/waiting pipeline child processes. Source-only lifecycle findings.
Preview display callback checks current path before applying image, preventing ordinary late previews of a different selected file; useful source-level guard.
File trash action occurs before in-memory/hash updates. Hash remove subprocess failure merely logged, then cache saved; partial-update concern source-only. No trash, delete or remove action executed.
remaining: Whole pinned dependency headers, build/package files, stored assets and upstream end-to-end runtime
